name: Generate a Semantic-Layer Data Product from a Schema

checks.check: models.py declares two semantic_model(...) objects (customer_profile, order_event), each with a {"kind": "grain"} __nxd_semantic__ blob on its key column (CUSTOMER_ID and ORDER_ID respectively).

A metric blob on AMOUNT_USD uses agg "sum" (total_revenue) and a metric blob counting orders uses agg "count_distinct" on ORDER_ID (order_count). Each is a {"kind": "metric", "agg": ...} __nxd_semantic__ blob, not a fluent SemanticRegistry().metric() call.

The churned-customer-count metric (on IS_CHURNED) and the first-order-count metric (on IS_FIRST_ORDER) set "boolean": true in their metric blobs so the compiler emits a boolean CASE-sum rather than a numeric cast, instead of treating the flag column as a numeric SUM.
The order_event CUSTOMER_ID attribute carries a {"kind": "join", "to_model": "customer_profile", "cardinality": "many_to_one"} blob (directly, or inside a {"roles": [...]} multi-role wrapper).
The EMAIL and FULL_NAME dimension blobs set "pii": true, and no other dimension blob is marked pii.

spec.py exposes the MCP tools via a single .semantic_tools(service=...) call. It does NOT hand-wire build_semantic_tools + rpc_function + rpc_server, and does NOT call data_product_rpc_output() directly (that raises ValidationError alongside .semantic_tools()).

spec.py promises every annotated model (customer_profile and order_event) on a plain storage(...) port via data_product_output().promise(...), so their attributes reach the kernel manifest and the .nxd/semantic/<model>.json payloads. The storage port is NOT configured with as_view(...).

transform.py seeds the base tables (CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE + write_pandas) and is wired via .transform(code(transform)...). There is NO @on_provision hook, NO .provision(...) call, and NO semantic-view (CREATE VIEW / SEMANTIC VIEW) DDL anywhere.

The agent does NOT re-implement or vendor the compiler / tool factory (no hand-written compile_selection, filter, or aggregation logic, no copied nxd.experimental.semantic source). The tools are auto-generated by the .semantic_tools() flag from the installed wheel.
The project's dependency file lists nxd.data_product[spec], nxd.drivers[rpc], snowflake-connector-python[pandas], pandas, and pyyaml (>=6.0.2) for the split-pod manifest fallback.
